vision.name: Namekian Straining Assault
vision.text:
ENDURANCE 2.
(Limit 1 per deck. While 2 or more Earth Dragon Balls you own are in play, you may banish this card from your hand to cancel an effect that would banish an [Trait:Earthling] Ally in play.)
[Attack] Energy attack.
Your MP may pay any amount of stages. If five or more stages are paid, search your Life Deck or discard pile for an [Trait:Earthling] Ally and play it.
DAMAGE: 4 life cards.
(Created by Thomas DiLena, OP3 East Kai Champion)
vision.note: Organized Play card (OP3); both inline icons zoomed: blue Capsule Corp E badge (Earthling); prints a design credit line
